_note: Played once when Fern hides behind the log in the rogue camp (Story Part C). Steps: see scripts/core/cutscene.gd. Vex and Slate are placeholder names.

steps.text: A Clan apprentice found me by the river. Sniffing around like they own the place.
They think they do. Did you lead them here?
Still sulking. He fought hard for a scrawny thing.
{name_wick} is worth more to us awake than hurt.
He knows their patrol times, their borders, which elders are weak.
The loners by the twoleg fences already listen to us. The old fox-den cats too.
One Clan's worth of land, and every stray in the forest will follow us.
And if the Clan comes for him?
Then we see how brave they really are. Let them come to us.
They're gathering loners... and they have {name_wick}. I have to warn {name_rook}.
